description.value:
Midnight Arms' light machine gun is "light" in name only. The MA70 HB is a bona fide steel cannon for your personal arsenal. This American manufacturer built its reputation on supplying police departments and security agencies. While their designs aren't always the sleekest, they are undeniably solid and available at reasonable prices. Should you dare to shoulder their behemoth LMG, the MA70 HB, it's wise to first install cyberware to reinforce your upper body and spine.

Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Machine Gun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 60 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Bipod, Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: All ammunition fired from this weapon also functions as Explosive Ammunition, but does not suffer its -2 Attack Check penalty. When making an Autofire Attack with this weapon, if the DV to hit is only beat by 1, the Attack still has an Autofire Rating of (x2). Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions. Requires BODY 10+ to not reduce MOVE by 2 while wielded and not Mounted, and BODY 12+ to not inflict the Torn Muscle Critical Injury when fired in Autofire or Suppressive Fire, unless it is Mounted. A Nomad may choose to receive this weapon when they first install a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount.

Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
